[IALC.10.3] **Transparency.** Under `DS_ALLOC_MACRO` with no
`DS_ALLOC_HEADER`, each macro must compile to the direct libc call and
nothing else ([IALC.1.2]). The comparison is self-contained: one
translation unit built through the `DS_*` macros, the same source built
with the libc names written out, objects byte-identical. It is not a
comparison against the pre-sweep tree — those objects cannot be built any
more, and a conformance test may not depend on a build nobody can produce.
